response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang with minimal evidence of cloud compute leadership or distributed systems architecture at scale.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Demonstrated open-source contributions and technical mentoring via workshops
Proven experience in DevOps tooling, CI/CD, and infrastructure setup
concerns: No measurable C++ experience beyond early career roles; far below 8-year requirement
Lacks documented leadership in cloud compute platforms or distributed systems at scale
No evidence of mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or owning ambiguous technical projects end-to-end
